answer: Vote weight is minted only by locking a slashable stake that decays toward a nadir whenever the agent's graded work is disputed. A sybil ring with N clones must post N overlapping stakes, yet the protocol caps weight per verified stake unit, so the ring cannot amplify influence past what it paid. Each fresh key also needs onyx-priced capacity from an issuer that audits provenance, and one upheld fraud finding burns it. Honest agents lock capital once and recover it; fake identities add cost with no return, so the attack scales linearly in money and jade bounties make it worse.
